# SchemaCraft AI

> Free SEO audit and JSON-LD schema generator. Scores are computed only from HTML the server actually retrieved.

## Product
SchemaCraft AI (https://schemacraft-ai.site) audits a public URL by fetching it from SchemaCraft servers (`POST /api/audit`). The report includes final HTTP status, redirects, headers, HTML, robots.txt, and JSON-LD blocks. If HTML is missing, no overall score is shown. Checks without evidence are labeled Not assessed.

A free audit does not require an account. Full audit access is $9 USD one-time with a 30-day refund via support@schemacraft-ai.site. Valid Schema.org markup does not guarantee a Google rich result.
